description:
Permanently revoke one delegated key by delegate_id, or all active delegated keys when revoke_all=true. Use this to disable compromised or retired subagents; do not use for a temporary whole-account pause (x402_set_account_freeze) or cap edits (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: pass delegate_id or revoke_all=true (revoke_all takes precedence if both set); supply master spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: irreversible — revoked keys immediately fail HTTP 401. Safe to retry (already-revoked or 0 active return HTTP 200); HTTP 403 delegates, HTTP 404 unknown.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

reason.description: Optional audit-log reason recorded on swarm revocations when revoke_all=true (e.g. "key_rotated" or "compromised_worker").

revoke_all.description: Set true to execute the emergency swarm kill switch revoking EVERY active delegated subagent key on the account (omit delegate_id when true).

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_revoke_delegate_key

revoked.description: True when a single delegated key was revoked.

revoked_count.description: Number of delegated keys revoked when revoke_all=true.

title: Revoke Delegated Subagent Key
